title: Hardship Settlement Due-Date Extensions: Standard Grant and Limits
content:
# Hardship Settlement — Extension Days

**The grant.** For a due-date extension on an accepted Hardship Settlement of Ridgeline's Settlement Agreements, the Hardship Settlement extension days are a standard grant of 5 calendar days, never fewer than one day and never more than the programme's extension maximum of 15 calendar days.

**Its effect.** The extension adds those days to the settlement's extension days total and to its final payment due date, so every unpaid payment falls due that many days later.

**Forming the figure.** The extension days are the standard grant together with any allowances that apply, added to it once and held between one day and the 15-calendar-day extension maximum; the days finally granted, with any change to the day of the week on which the extended due date falls, are again held between one day and 15 calendar days.

## Records the extension works from

The accepted Hardship Settlement shows its acceptance date, its first payment due date and its extension days total, from which each payment's due date and the days added by earlier extensions are read.

## Hypothetical worked example

| Item | Before | After a 5-day extension |
|---|---|---|
| Extension days total | 0 | 5 |
| Payment 2 due (unpaid) | day P | day P plus 5 |
| Payment 3 due (unpaid) | day P plus 30 | day P plus 35 |
| Final payment due date | day P plus 30 | day P plus 35 |

## Limits at a glance

| Limit | Figure |
|---|---|
| Standard grant | 5 calendar days |
| Fewest days granted | 1 day |
| Most days granted by one extension | 15 calendar days |
